description: This file defines the SelectInterface, a PHP interface for building and manipulating SQL SELECT queries within Drupal's database API. It includes methods for query construction, such as adding fields, joins, conditions, and executing the query.

classes.name: SelectInterface
classes.description: Interface for a SQL SELECT query object, providing methods for query building, execution, and modification within Drupal's database abstraction layer.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of fields to be selected, allowing direct modification.

methods.name: getExpressions
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of expressions to be selected.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of order-by clauses.

methods.name: getGroupBy
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of group-by clauses.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of tables involved in the query.

methods.name: getUnion
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array of union queries.

methods.name: escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes wildcard characters in a string for LIKE patterns, delegating to Connection::escapeLike().

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Sanitizes a field name to be alphanumeric plus underscore, possibly adding database-specific escape characters.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns an array of placeholder arguments for the query, optionally accepting a subquery placeholder object.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Sets whether the query should be DISTINCT.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to the SELECT clause, returning its alias.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Adds multiple fields from a table to the SELECT clause.

methods.name: addExpression
methods.description: Adds an expression to the SELECT clause, returning its alias.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Default join method, a convenience for innerJoin().

methods.name: innerJoin
methods.description: Performs an INNER JOIN with another table or subquery.

methods.name: leftJoin
methods.description: Performs a LEFT OUTER JOIN with another table or subquery.

methods.name: addJoin
methods.description: Adds a join of specified type with another table or subquery.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Adds an ORDER BY clause for a specific field and direction.

methods.name: orderRandom
methods.description: Orders the result set randomly.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Limits the result set to a range of rows.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Adds a union query to this query.

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Adds a GROUP BY clause.

methods.name: countQuery
methods.description: Returns a COUNT(*) version of this query.

methods.name: isPrepared
methods.description: Checks if preExecute() has been called.

methods.name: preExecute
methods.description: Prepares and validates the query before execution.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the query against the database.

methods.name: havingCondition
methods.description: Adds a condition to the HAVING clause, with flexible parameters.

methods.name: havingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions in the HAVING clause for modification.

methods.name: havingArguments
methods.description: Returns placeholder arguments for HAVING conditions.

methods.name: having
methods.description: Adds an arbitrary HAVING clause snippet.

methods.name: havingCompile
methods.description: Compiles the HAVING clause for SQL.

methods.name: havingIsNull
methods.description: Adds a condition that a field is NULL in HAVING.

methods.name: havingIsNotNull
methods.description: Adds a condition that a field is NOT NULL in HAVING.

methods.name: havingExists
methods.description: Adds a condition that a subquery returns results in HAVING.

methods.name: havingNotExists
methods.description: Adds a condition that a subquery returns no results in HAVING.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Deep clones the query object, excluding the connection.

methods.name: forUpdate
methods.description: Adds FOR UPDATE to lock selected rows.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representation of the query.
